Torrents through Linksnappy, and a security and reliability pass over the whole code. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ✨ Added

- **Torrents through Linksnappy.** Linksnappy fetches magnet links and `.torrent` files like the other debrid services. Rank it above the built-in torrent client on the Accounts page and it takes them. ([#61](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/61))

## ⚡ Improved

- **An instance without a password answers only on names it knows:** IP addresses, `localhost`, names without a dot, `.local`, `.lan`, `.home.arpa` and `.internal` names, its host name and the domains under Known domains. A web page can no longer reach it through DNS rebinding. If you open a passwordless instance through your own domain, add that domain under Settings > Remote access.
- **Changing the password signs out every other browser,** and signing out ends that session for good.
- **Sign-in is harder to guess through.** The attempt limit holds against parallel tries, request bodies have a size limit, and the server drops connections that sit idle.
- **The relay and the pairing trust only sealed announcements,** and a relay you serve yourself admits your phrase group.
- **Crawls and feeds stay inside the network of the address you entered,** so a public page or feed cannot point KnightLoader at a machine on your LAN.
- **Passwords of hosters and debrid services stay out of logs,** task errors and the diagnostics bundle.
- **A damaged `settings.json`, `accounts.json` or key file is kept as a copy** instead of being replaced, and the start report names it.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Pausing or removing a download while its link resolves holds,** and a finished download can no longer be pushed back into the queue.
- **A torrent the built-in client has partly fetched keeps its progress after a restart** instead of going to a debrid service.
- **The end-of-queue action waits** for files that are still being checked or moved and for pending retries.
- **A package named `..` cannot put files outside the download folder,** and unpacking leaves archives that were already in a folder alone.
- **A failed TorBox web download ends** instead of being asked about forever, and a changed hoster login reaches JDownloader.
- **The Windows desktop app writes its log again.**
- **Schedules catch up after the computer has slept.**
- **The quick-add page shows the links and waits for Add** instead of queuing them as soon as it opens.
- **The browser extension keeps the phrase out of reach of web pages,** and several extension sessions no longer push each other out.
